heading: Meet the Team
intro: The people who help bring the magic to Sane Living Center, from the first walk-through to the last song.

members.name: Carol Cilliers Blaschke
members.bio:
Carol Cilliers Blaschke is the owner of Sacred Living Ojai, formerly the Sane Living Center. Partner to the late founder Aubrey Balkind, she is now the Center’s sole owner and, together with her team, is relaunching it as a welcoming home for gatherings both sacred and everyday.

Carol brings five decades of metaphysical study and seasoned business experience to the role, along with a commitment to opening the doors wider for the community, from Ojai locals to guests from far and wide. She looks forward to bringing your special event to life here in the Valley of the Moon.

members.name: Karol Avalon
members.role: Director of Special Events & Operations Manager
members.bio:
With more than four decades in hospitality and events, Karol is one of the steady pulses of Sane Living Center’s heartbeat. As Director of Special Events and Operations Manager, she guides each gathering from the first walk-through to the final farewell and keeps the Center running smoothly day to day, bringing calm organization, warm hospitality and an eye for the details that make an event feel effortless.

Her career has included producing inspirational conferences and retreats, creating and leading multi-day events at sea with Life Journeys Global production company, providing sales and marketing expertise to Sonoma County boutique inns and serving as Vice President of Merchandising for the Red Rose Collection. She brings every bit of her vast experience to each client who walks through Sane Living’s purple doors.
